Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center. EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: Ilwww_ dilg.gov.ph OPINION NO. L5 1 SEP S. 2DE HON. DONNA ANGELA P. YATCO Sangguniang Panlungsod Member Bifian City, Laguna Dear Hon. Yatco: This has reference to your letter dated 3 August 2017 which we received on 8 August 2017 requesting this Department's opinion relative to your query on the proper procedure in the Sanggunian and matters that will be included or excluded in the agenda of the Sanggunian, and we quote: "What will be the Proper Procedure when a Sanggunian Member has officially expressed in a written letter, the concern of our constituents and has requested that the said matter be included in the Agenda of the Sanggunian Session. " The Local Government Code (LGC), specifically Section 50 provides as follows: SECTION 50. Internal Rules of Procedure. — (a) On the first regular session following the election OT its members and within ninety (90) days thereafter, the Sanggunian concerned shall adopt or update its existing rules 0Tprocedure. (b) The rules of procedure shall provide for the following: (I) The organization of the Sanggunian and the election of its officers as well as the creation of standing committees which shall include, but shall not be limited to, the committees on appropriations, women and family, human rights, youth and sports development, environmental protection, and cooperatives; the general jurisdiction of

each committee; and the election of the chairman and members of each committee; (2) The order and calendar of business Tor each session; (3) The legislative process; (4) The parliamentaryprocedures which include the conduct of mem bers during sessions; (5) The discipline of members for disorderly behavior and absences without justifiable cause for four (4) consecutive sessions, Tor vvhich they may be censured, reprimanded, or excluded from the session, suspended for not more than sixty (60) days, or expelled: Provided, That the penalty of suspension or expulsion shall require the concurrence OT at least two-thirds (2/3) vote of all the Sanggunian members: Provided, further, That a member convicted by final judgment to imprisonment of at least one (I) year for any crime involving moral turpitude shall be automatically expelled from the Sanggunian; and (6) Such other rules as the Sanggunian may adopt. Accordingly, based on the herein-cited provision of the LGC, the matters to be included or excluded in the agenda of the Sanggunian should be provided by the Internal Rules of Procedure (IRP), and in case of non-inclusion thereof, it should be decided by the Sanggunian. It bears to emphasize that a Sanggunian is a collective body, hence, any im ortant decision that the San unian will render must alwa be done b a I •n the rule of majority.l Furthermore, it was also mentioned in your letter that during the session of the Sanggunian, its power of oversight was raised in relation to the proper implementation of the measures it passed. It is settled that Sanggunian is vested with the inherent power to oversee that duly approved ordinances and other measures were efficiently, effectively and adequately executed by the Local Chief Executive.2 In consideration of the above premises, it is this Department's view that the decision on what will be included or excluded in the agenda of the Sanggunian, including its exercise of the power of oversight, is an internal matter, and should be decided by the majority of the Sanggunian members concerned. DILG Opinion No. 9, s. 2009 2 DILG Opinion No. 1, s. 2007

In this case, this Department finds nowhere in your letter and its attachments that the decision to strike out in the Sanggunian agenda the complaint raised on the weighing scale cheating of vendors at the Bifian Public Market was voted by the majority of the Sanggunian members. Minutes of the 26 July 2017 session stated only in its line 37 that "The said motion is hereby approved by the Presiding Officer", but nowhere therein can be perceived that there was a division of the house on the herein matter. Wherefore, absent of the majority vote of the Sanggunian members in striking out of the agenda will render the said action improper. We hope we have guided you accordingly. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: AUSTERE A. •PANADERO Undersecretary DILG - OUSLG 201 -0 18-0 6 Copy furnished: Dir.
